title: 2009_PMC2685976_A_liposome-based_mycobacterial_vaccine_induces_potent_adult_and_
ehr_evidence: The study used no electronic health records; data were generated from experimental immunization of C57BL/6 mice (7 days of age, neonates, or 8–12 weeks old, adults) followed by Mycobacterium bovis BCG challenge and immune readouts.
summary: A preclinical murine study showing that the CAF01 adjuvant with Ag85B-ESAT-6 confers similar protection against M. bovis BCG challenge and induces adult-like multifunctional Th1/Th17 CD4+ T cells in both neonatal and adult mice, via sustained but limited dendritic cell targeting.
key_findings: Ag85B-ESAT-6/CAF01 significantly reduced bacterial CFU counts in spleen and lungs versus Alum and control (p<0.05) in both neonatal and adult mice, whereas Alum conferred no protection.
Ag85B-ESAT-6/CAF01 induced similarly high IFN-γ and modest IL-5 responses in adults and neonates, unlike Alum which produced a Th2-preferential pattern.
Multifunctional Th1 cells persisted at high levels at 6 months, even after a single neonatal dose (Table 1).

Very few dendritic cells in draining lymph nodes bore the labeled antigen/adjuvant (0.09±0.04% of total DCs; ~523±254 Ag+Adj+ DCs per adult mouse), indicating potent adjuvanticity was not mediated by massive DC targeting.
CD40 and CD86 activation was restricted to the minute adjuvant-bearing DC population, and IL-12p40 was not detected in any sample.
Ag-specific CD8+ T cells were not detected, indicating protection is associated with Th1 and Th17 CD4+ T cells.
captured_features: Spleen and lung CFU counts after mycobacterial challenge
Cytokine levels (IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-2, IL-17, IL-5) by ELISA/ELISPOT/flow cytometry
Frequency of antigen-specific CD4+ T cell subsets
Dendritic cell proportions and numbers in draining lymph nodes
CD40 and CD86 co-stimulation marker expression on DCs
study_design: Preclinical experimental immunization and challenge model in neonatal and adult mice
population: C57BL/6 mice, neonatal (1 week old) and adult (8–12 weeks old)
exposure_domain: Vaccine/adjuvant (CAF01 cationic liposome with Ag85B-ESAT-6 antigen)
limitations: Mouse model may not reliably predict human vaccine efficacy
Fluorochrome labeling may not reveal the full labeled cell population
Duration of DC recruitment/activation difficult to estimate due to detection limits
